title: Fragment
description: A run of consecutive lines of a file, each line under its number, of one of two kinds: a surface fragment, which the change added or removed and a violation may anchor on, or a context fragment, which stands around the change and no violation anchors on

SurfaceFragment.description: Lines the change added, on side head and numbered in the file at the head commit, or removed, on side base and numbered in the file at the base. An anchor copies these lines as they stand

ContextFragment.description: Lines the change left as they were, handed so that a rule can be judged on the whole file; no violation anchors on them
